lemmas.name: B21e_sketch_not_X_a_priori

lemmas.why: Scored as B32. A short window is not the sitting of B11c. The sketch grew. The field fell. Finer box is not an a priori (B22e). DNS leftover is B23e.

lemmas.name: B21f_not_a_pde_retune

lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. c is a knob on the estimate. No Q1. No ε. Do not type B11c into the equation.
